title: Terraflux model
description: A Terraflux model file (format terraflux/1) in its JSON form. A TOML model maps one to one: parse the TOML into data and validate that. Objects accept keys the schema does not name, as Terraflux does when it reads a file (it ignores them, and drops them when it saves the model again). Some rules here (valid names, the form of references) are applied by `terraflux check` and not by loading.

format.description: The version of the model format. The only value this version of Terraflux reads is terraflux/1; any other is refused.

name.description: The model's name, shown in the application's title and in reports.

description.description: What the model is, in a sentence or two.

request.description: The request the model answers, in the words of whoever asked for it. Part of the record; it changes no result.

summary.description: A summary of the conversation or the work that led to the model. Part of the record; it changes no result.

author.description: Who made the model: a person, an assistant, or both. Part of the record; it changes no result.

inputs.description: The data the model reads, by name. A node reads one as "$name". A name is a letter or underscore followed by letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

nodes.description: The operators of the graph, in any order: they run in the order of their dependencies. Node ids are unique within their level. Absent means no nodes.

outputs.description: What the model writes into the output folder, by name.

parameters.description: The values offered in a form to change a scenario without touching the graph, in the order shown. They do not change what the model gives.

scenarios.description: Sets of values of the parameters kept by name, to run and compare.

tests.description: What `terraflux test` checks: an output of the model against the file of what it should be.

plots.description: The views of the results kept with the model (what the Viewer shows, saved). They sit outside the graph; the Document, the reports, the QGIS export and the Python script read them.

places.description: Layout only. Where the canvas draws the boxes of what a scope reads besides its nodes (a model's input, a container's value, a node outside it), moved by hand. The key is the scope's container ids joined by "/", then "|", then the reference ("|$land", "loop|@step"). The value is [x, y].

notes.description: Layout only. The notes and frames drawn on the canvas, for whoever reads the model. Checks and runs never see them.

bookmarks.description: Layout only. Views of the Viewer's map and of the canvas kept by name, to go back to (optionally in a slot, 1 to 9).

id.description: A name: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (ASCII only).

reference.description: A reference to a value: "node.port" (an output of a node), "$name" (an input of the model) or "@name" (a value of the enclosing container).

point.description: A point [x, y] in the coordinates of the canvas (graph units) of its scope.

type.description: The type of a value that flows along the graph.

input.description: Data the model reads. The kind says which: a map, a stack of maps, or a value.

kind.description: One band of a raster file.

path.description: The raster file. A relative path is relative to the model's folder.

band.description: The band, by name or 0-based index (default: the first).

nodata.description: A no-data value that replaces the file's.

note.description: What the input is, as its maker wrote it.

kind.description: Every band of a raster file (or the bands named): a stack of maps.

path.description: The raster file. A relative path is relative to the model's folder.

bands.description: The bands to read, by name (default: all of them).

nodata.description: A no-data value that replaces the file's.

note.description: What the input is, as its maker wrote it.

kind.description: A number or any structured value (a seed, a table of demands).

value.description: The value: any JSON value (a TOML value of any type).

note.description: What the input is, as its maker wrote it.

id.description: The node's name, unique among the nodes of its level. Other nodes read its outputs as "id.port".

op.description: The operator, such as raster.read or control.repeat. See the operator reference for the list, ports and settings. The names stack.layer and map.calc are read as stack.extract_layer and raster.calc.

inputs.description: What the node's input ports read, by port name. A text is a reference ("node.port", "$name" or "@name"); any other value (number, boolean, list, table) is a literal. A text can never be a literal input.

params.description: The node's settings, by name. A value is a literal, a text "$name" or "@name" that reads a model input or a container value, or a table { from = "node.port" } that reads a node's output. A setting the operator does not read is kept, and `terraflux check` warns of it.

note.description: What the node is for, in a sentence. Part of the record; it changes no result.

why.description: Why this operator and these settings were chosen. Part of the record; it changes no result.

refs.description: The references the choice rests on (papers, methods, the operator's documentation), as free text. Part of the record.

assumptions.description: What the node assumes to be true. Part of the record.

alternatives.description: The alternatives considered and set aside, and why. Part of the record.

body.description: The nodes of a container (control.repeat, control.each, control.switch, control.group), with what it carries, collects and gives. Required of a container, refused on any other operator, by `terraflux check`.

pos.description: Layout only. Where the node editor draws the node, in its scope's coordinates.

wires.description: Layout only. Reroute points of the wires the node reads, by input port name, or "setting:<name>" for the wire into a setting. Each value is a list of [x, y] points from the output to the input.

width.description: Layout only. The width the node's box was given in the editor, never narrower than its texts need.

bypass.description: Turn the node off without taking it away: it does not run, and each of its outputs is the first of its inputs of the same type (default false). This changes the results.

frozen.description: Keep the node's outputs on disk next to the model (<model>.frozen/<id>/) and use them instead of running the node, until it is thawed. Top-level nodes only (default false).

shown.description: Layout only. Settings the node's box always shows, beyond those it chooses itself.

hidden.description: Layout only. Settings the node's box never shows folded (they stay in the settings panel).

uses.description: Set on a control.group that is a node of the user's library: the name and version it was made from, and what it takes and gives.

body.description: The body of a container: its nodes, and how values pass through it.

nodes.description: The nodes inside the container. Their ids are unique among themselves, and they read the container's values as "@name" and any node of an enclosing level as "node.port".

carry.description: control.repeat: "@name" to the reference whose value becomes @name in the next step. The first value is the container's input of the same name.

collect.description: control.repeat and control.each: output name to the reference whose value at every step (or element) is collected into a series, a stack or a table.

outputs.description: control.group (and what a submodel becomes): output name to the reference that gives it, read outside as "container.name".

order.description: Layout only. The order a group's outputs are shown in (output names). Those not listed come after, by name.

until.description: control.repeat: a reference to a yes-or-no value. When it is true at the end of a step, the loop ends there, and that step is neither collected nor carried.

uses.description: A group that is a node of the user's library.

version.description: The version the group's body is a copy of.

inputs.description: What it takes, by name ("@name" in its body).

bands.description: For a stack, the layers it needs, by the names a script reads them.

default.description: Its value when none is given (the input is then optional).

outputs.description: What it gives, by name (the body's outputs).

path.description: The file, relative to the output folder (default: the output's name with the usual extension).

dtype.description: The cell type of a raster: u8, i32, f32 and so on.

layer.description: One layer of a stack (or of rasters, or one step of a series) written alone: its name or 0-based number, as text.

parameter.description: A value of the model offered in a form, with what the form needs to show and bound it.

key.description: What it changes: "$name" (a value input) or "node.setting" ("container/node.setting" inside a container).

label.description: Its name in the form (default: the key).

min.description: The smallest value (a slider when min and max are both given).

choices.description: The values it takes, when they are a few.

help.description: What it is and how it acts on the model, for whoever changes it.

scenario.description: A named set of values of the model's parameters.

values.description: Parameter key to value, the keys as in a parameter's key ("$name" or "node.setting").

test.description: A test of the model: a value it gives against the file of what it should be.

expected.description: The file of what it should be (a raster, a table, a JSON value or a text), relative to the model's folder.

tolerance.description: The largest difference of a number allowed (default 1e-9).

plot.description: A view of the model's results kept with it.

id.description: The plot's name, unique among the plots.

title.description: The plot's title, its caption in the Document.

layers.description: What it shows, the first at the bottom.

compare.description: A map compared with the top map.

chart.description: A table's chart, when a layer is a table.

note.description: What the plot shows. Part of the record.

why.description: Why it is shown. Part of the record.

view.description: The saved view: the part of the map the plot is drawn at.

extent.description: West, south, east, north, in the coordinates of the map. It must have an area.

groups.description: Groups of layers, one level; a layer is in one by its group.

id.description: The group's id, named by its layers' group.

name.description: The group's name in the Viewer's list.

collapsed.description: Its layers folded under its row (default false).

hidden.description: Its layers kept without being drawn (default false).

opacity.description: How opaque, 0 to 1 (default 1). It multiplies its layers' opacity.

plot_layer.description: A layer of a plot: an output or an input of the model, and how it is drawn.

from.description: The layer: "node.port", "$name", or a node inside containers ("group.inner.port" or "group/inner.port").

palette.description: The palette, by its name in the Viewer (default: by what the map is).

range.description: The range of the colours of a map of values, [least, most] (default: the 2nd to 98th percentiles).

band.description: The band of a stack or the step of a loop shown (default the first).

style.description: Style of vector features, as the Viewer keeps it (any value).

minus.description: Drawn as a difference: from minus this map, for maps of values; the transitions from this map to from, for maps of classes.

minus_band.description: The band or step of minus (default the first).

hidden.description: Kept in the plot without being drawn (default false).

rgb.description: Drawn as a colour composite of three maps.

bands.description: The bands (from 0) of the red, green and blue channels.

red.description: The range of the red channel's values.

green.description: The range of the green channel's values.

blue.description: The range of the blue channel's values.

gamma.description: The gamma of the three channels (default 1).

selected.description: Features of a vector layer selected in the attribute table, by number from 1.

blend.description: How the layer mixes with the ones under it: normal (default), multiply or screen.

shade.description: A map of values shaded as a relief made of itself.

azimuth.description: The sun's azimuth in degrees clockwise from north (default 315).

altitude.description: The sun's altitude over the horizon in degrees (default 45).

strength.description: How strong the shade is, 0 to 1 (default 0.6).

name.description: The name the Viewer's list, legend and figure give the layer, instead of its output's.

group.description: The id of the plot's group the layer is in.

plot_compare.description: A map compared with a plot's top map.

how.description: How: curtain, side by side (default) or difference.

also.description: Side by side, up to two more maps, each in a view of its own.

band.description: The band or step of with (default the first).

also_bands.description: The bands of the also maps, one each (0 or missing: the first).

layers.description: The layers of the views side by side, the first the view of with, then those of also: a list each, the first layer at the bottom.

kind.description: bars, lines, points or boxes (default: suggested by the table).

by.description: The column whose values make the groups.

note.description: A note on the canvas: a text put somewhere (at), or a frame around nodes (nodes), whose text's first line is its title.

id.description: The note's id (note1, frame1 and so on), unique among the notes.

scope.description: The ids of the containers, from the top, whose level the note is on (empty or absent: the top level).

text.description: The text (a frame's title is its first line).

colour.description: The note's colour: amber, blue, green, red, purple or grey (absent: the note's own).

at.description: Where a free note is put, in graph units.

nodes.description: The ids of the nodes a frame goes around. A note with nodes is a frame: its rectangle is the nodes' boxes'.

slot.description: The digit that goes to it, 1 to 9; one place of each kind to a slot.

view.description: What the place keeps. The kind says which: the Viewer's map or the canvas.

kind.description: A part of a map in the Viewer.

extent.description: West, south, east, north, in the coordinates of the map shown.

crs.description: The map's coordinate system, as the map tells it (absent for a map without one).

layers.description: The layers visible when it was saved (the from of each, as the plots tell them).

scope.description: The container whose body it shows, its path joined by "/" (empty: the top level).

x.description: The graph point at the middle of the view, x.

y.description: The graph point at the middle of the view, y.
